title: Mackerel with lentils and tomatoes
summary: Mackerel with lentils and tomatoes is a italian dinner built around mackerel fillets and canned green lentils, with the portions weighed so each serving stays under 700 kcal.

steps.instruction: Pat mackerel fillets dry and season it. Prep canned green lentils and cherry tomatoes for Mackerel with lentils and tomatoes so the pan is not waiting.
steps.tip: Dry protein browns. Wet protein steams and turns grey.

steps.instruction: Heat the oil and cook mackerel fillets on both sides until done. Lift it out to rest.
In the same pan, cook canned green lentils and cherry tomatoes in the leftover juices until tender. Add any lemon, mustard or herbs.
steps.tip: Taste Mackerel with lentils and tomatoes before serving and add a squeeze of lemon if it wants brightness.

steps.instruction: Slice mackerel fillets and serve it with the vegetables and pan juices.
